responsibility: Is the autogenerated documentation-link companion for the Arm VxWorks-specific option fragment vxworks.opt. Like other .opt.urls files, it exists to associate option-table entries with manual URL suffixes in generated option metadata, but in this case currently contains only the autogenerated prologue because the VxWorks compatibility driver options in that fragment do not have populated URL mappings. It serves as the placeholder documentation map for the VxWorks Arm option subset.
